# Bruce Lui — Product Designer

Bruce Lui is a product designer based in Amsterdam, specialising in fintech, search, and mobile UX.

## About

Bruce designs digital products with a focus on clarity, usability, and craft. He has worked on banking apps, search engines, and travel platforms.

## Portfolio

- Homepage: https://brucelui.github.io/
- N26 case study: https://brucelui.github.io/n26.html — redesigning the N26 mobile banking experience (Spaces, onboarding, transaction flows)
- Ecosia case study: https://brucelui.github.io/ecosia.html — designing search experiences at Ecosia (AI search, discovery, sustainable UX)
- trivago case study: https://brucelui.github.io/trivago.html — redesigning the trivago hotel search experience (search UX, filters, booking flows)
